business_scope.primary_industry_name: Stock Photography Marketplace and Generative Visual Assets

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Mainland China as the WFOE incorporation jurisdiction, with Taiwan as the designated source/investor jurisdiction
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law; socialist legal tradition in mainland China, and parallel civil-law regime for the Taiwanese investor
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No formal bilateral investment treaty exists between the PRC and Taiwan because Taiwan is not a sovereign counterparty under PRC law; the operational framework is the cross-strait investment regime.
Economic Cooperation Framework Agreement (ECFA), signed at Chongqing on 29 June 2010, effective 12 September 2010.
Cross-Strait Agreement on Investment Protection and Promotion, signed 9 August 2012.
Cross-Strait Agreement on Avoidance of Double Taxation and Strengthening of Tax Cooperation, signed 25 August 2015.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: The PRC governs the WFOE's AML/CFT and UBO duties. Applicable citations include: Anti-Money Laundering Law of the People's Republic of China (2024 revised text, effective 1 January 2025); Measures for the Administration of Beneficial Owner Information, jointly issued by the People's Bank of China and the State Administration for Market Regulation as PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3 [2024], effective 1 November 2024; Company Law of the People's Republic of China (2023 revision, effective 1 July 2024); Foreign Investment Law of the PRC (2020) and its implementing regulations; and SAMR market-entity registration rules. Taiwan's Money Laundering Control Act and Company Act govern the Taiwanese investing entity's internal creation of documents, but those Taiwanese rules do not displace PRC UBO filing obligations for the WFOE.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Division
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only; Taiwan is not a Hague Apostille Convention contracting party, so an Apostille must never be appended. The certificate must be notarized by a Taiwan district court notary, authenticated by the Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and then processed through the cross-strait Straits Exchange Foundation / Association for Relations Across the Taiwan Straits verification mechanism for presentation to PRC authorities.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwan Ministry of Economic Affairs, Company Registration Section
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only; no Hague Apostille is available because Taiwan is not an Apostille member. A recently issued good-standing certificate must be notarized in Taiwan, the notary seal authenticated by the Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and the document legalized through the cross-strait verification channel; online unverified extracts are not acceptable.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution and Power of Attorney of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwanese investing company's board of directors
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only: the resolution and power of attorney must be notarized under Taiwan's notary procedures, authenticated by the Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and verified through the cross-strait document exchange for use in the PRC; if a signatory is absent, a legalized copy of the signatory list and notarized specimen signatures must be attached.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / corporate charter of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwanese investing company as filed with the Taiwan company registry
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only: a certified copy of the articles must be notarized by a Taiwan notary, authenticated by the Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and legalized through the cross-strait verification mechanism for presentation to SAMR, MOFCOM, and the target bank. A certified simplified-Chinese translation must accompany the foreign-language document.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter of the Taiwanese investing company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Taiwanese investing company's relationship bank licensed under Taiwan's Banking Act
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization route only: the bank letter must be on original bank letterhead, signed by two bank officers, notarized in Taiwan, authenticated by the Taiwan Ministry of Foreign Affairs, and processed through the cross-strait verification exchange; faxed, scanned, or stale letters will be rejected by PRC banks and the WFOE's future account-opening KYC process.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening must be completed before incorporation against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List, the UN Security Council consolidated list, the EU and UK HMT financial sanctions lists, the PRC PBOC and MAAM's public lists, and Taiwan's own AML/CFT suspicious activity and wanted-criminal databases. Identify all UBOs, directors, senior managers, and authorized signatories, including Taiwanese and mainland Chinese PEPs, and perform adverse-media and source-of-wealth diligence. Because the stock-photo and AI visual-assets activity is classified as low-risk, standard due diligence applies, but any PEP match, sanctions hit, unusually opaque corporate chain, or cross-strait political exposure triggers enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and a suspicious transaction report if required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: SAMR National Enterprise Name Self-Service Declaration System and the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System operated by the State Administration for Market Regulation
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Registered names must be in simplified Chinese characters. The mandatory four-tier naming formula is: administrative division + distinctive trade name + industry or operation description + company type. The WFOE must use a Chinese organization form equivalent to limited liability. The distinctive element may be a simplified-Chinese transliteration of the Taiwanese parent's trade name, but only a Chinese name is registered; an English trade name is auxiliary and does not appear in the Chinese registration record unless separately approved. For a stock-photography and AI visual-assets business, the industry description must accurately reflect content production, image licensing, or digital visual assets and cannot imply a regulated financial activity.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: If SAMR rejects a proposed name, the system will issue a rejection reason code. Correct the defect and resubmit electronically; no fee is charged. If administrative rejection is believed unlawful, file a written administrative reconsideration application with the market-regulatory authority at the next higher level within 60 days from the rejection, attaching the rejection notice, translation, and charter. The reviewing authority must render a decision within 60 days. If the reconsideration is adverse or omitted, an administrative lawsuit may be filed in the competent people's court within six months of the reconsideration decision. Because a rejected name loses reservation priority, immediately reserve an alternative compliant name while pursuing the appeal.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A bare virtual office or commercial mailbox is not acceptable for a Chinese WFOE. SAMR requires a fixed, lawful, non-residential registered address with verifiable use rights; tax authorities require the same address to be capable of receiving inspection and service of process. In free-trade zones and qualified incubators, a registered-address hosting agreement may satisfy the registration formality, but Chinese banks will usually require a dedicated suite, lease invoice, and an on-site KYC visit before opening a settlement account. For this commercial stock-photo AI business, a serviced office or qualified incubator suite with an actual desk, employees, signboard, and business records is the minimum to avoid being labelled an abnormal tax registration. A pure virtual mailbox risks account refusal, tax invalidation, and regulatory inspection failure.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: approximately 35% probability of an unannounced SAMR or tax inspection within the first eighteen months under the 'double random, one public' mechanism. Inspection checklist includes: matching company nameplate at the registered address; original lease, property certificate, or incubator hosting agreement; visible WFOE business license; one or more employees present during working hours; authentic stock-photo licensing contracts, contributor agreements, and AI training-data provenance records; server or cloud subscription evidence; VAT invoices and accounting ledgers; bank statements and capital contribution records; UBO and PEP documentation; and company seal-control protocols. Non-compliance can lead to a 'cannot be located by registered address' listing, bank account freezing, or deregistration.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Taiwan Companies Act (as amended), Articles 1, 6, 7, 10, 15, 128, 154, 156, 161, 162, 172, 208 and 210; Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, Articles 4, 6, 8, 10; Ministry of Economic Affairs Foreign Investment Commission Rules and Department of Commercial Affairs Registration Regulations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs, Taiwan Company Registration One-Stop Online Service.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Registration Application Form (submitted through the MOEA One-Stop Portal) together with the Foreign Investment Approval Application form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital requirement for a Taiwan limited company. The Articles of Incorporation must state the total issued capital and the par value per share. All subscribed capital must be paid into a temporary corporate bank account in New Taiwan Dollars, retained until incorporation and released only after the company registration certificate is issued. A Taiwan-certified public accountant must issue a capital verification report unless the capital is less than the threshold exempting CPA audit by the MOEA. Foreign currency contributions must be remitted through a licensed bank and converted. The Board may also establish a shareholder loan in escrow, but such loan cannot be represented as paid-up capital.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLUTION NO. 2025-BOD-001 OF THE ORGANIZER AND FIRST BOARD OF DIRECTORS OF COMPANY NAME TAIWAN LIMITED, A TAIWAN COMPANY TO BE FORMED UNDER THE COMPANIES ACT. The first meeting of the subscriber/shareholders and the Board of Directors was duly convened on the date and at the place specified in the notice. The subscriber, being the sole incorporator, elected the initial directors, and the directors present, constituting a quorum, unanimously adopted the following resolutions with full force and effect: (1) SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION AND ISSUANCE. The Board approves the subscription, allotment, and issuance of NT$CAPITAL AMOUNT ordinary shares with par value NT$10 each, totaling NT$CAPITAL AMOUNT, to the sole foreign investor. The subscription price is fully paid in cash or in-kind by depositing such funds into the company's temporary capital collection account at DESIGNATED BANK before the filing of the incorporation application. The Board directs the General Manager and the appointed Taiwan certified public accountant to perform the capital verification process and file the capital verification report with the Ministry of Economic Affairs. (2) ADOPTION OF REGISTERED OFFICE. The registered office of the company is adopted and fixed at REGISTERED ADDRESS in Taipei, Taiwan, R.O.C. The office may be used for receipt of legal process and official correspondence; the lease, consent of the landlord, and building use compliance certificate must be delivered to the company secretary. The company shall not commence actual physical occupancy until local building and fire safety conditions are satisfied. (3) APPOINTMENT OF STATUTORY OFFICERS. The Board appoints NAME A as Chairperson and representative director, NAME B as General Manager, NAME C as Company Secretary, and NAME D as Chief Financial Officer and compliance officer. Each officer is empowered to sign incorporation documents, open bank accounts, execute leases, execute payment instructions, and represent the company before the Ministry of Economic Affairs, the National Taxation Bureau, labor insurance institutions, municipal business registries, and any other government agencies. (4) BANKING AUTHORIZATION. The Board selects BANK NAME as the company's primary banking institution. Any two of the Chairperson, the General Manager, and the Chief Financial Officer shall jointly sign all bank account opening forms, electronic banking authorities, corporate mandate cards, checks, wire transfer instructions, and all other banking documents. The bank is authorized to honor all instruments bearing any two of such authorized signatures. (5) GENERAL DELEGATION AND CONTINUITY. The Board authorizes the General Manager, under the supervision of the Chairperson, to make statutory filings under the Taiwan Companies Act, the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals, tax registration, labor and health insurance registration, and all registrations required for the internet-based stock photography and generative visual asset marketplace. Any decision outside the ordinary course of business, including amendment of the Articles of Incorporation, merger, issuance of new shares outside approved scope, or disposal of all or substantially all assets, requires a further resolution of the Board. The resolutions set forth in this instrument are effective immediately and continue until revised or revoked by the Board. Adopted, by unanimous vote, on this date. Chairman: NAME. Secretary: NAME.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Foreign Investor Approval and Name Reservation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Investment Services, Foreign Investment Commission
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the foreign investment application and the proposed company name reservation through the MOEA One-Stop Online Application System. The application must be filed by the foreign investor or its notarized legal representative using the form prescribed by the Statute for Investment by Foreign Nationals. Attach certified copies of the investor's business registration or passport, audited financial statements or bank reference, investment plan, power of attorney, and proposed Chinese and English names. Upon preliminary review, the Investment Commission issues a foreign investment approval letter, which is a prerequisite to opening a temporary capital account. Ensure the business scope is limited to information technology services and digital commerce so no physical approval is needed.
required_dossiers: MOEA Foreign Investment Application Form
Certified business registration certificate or passport of the foreign investor
Bank reference letter or audited financial statements
Notarized power of attorney
Investment plan and proposed Articles of Incorporation
Company name reservation form with three alternative names
Chinese translation of investor identification documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, respond in writing to the Investment Commission within 14 calendar days. If additional evidence of source of funds is requested, furnish a certified bank confirmation or corporate ownership chain. If the application is denied, submit a written request for reconsideration to the Department of Investment Services, and thereafter an administrative appeal to the Executive Yuan within 30 days; alternatively, re-file after narrowing the business scope.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Capital Remittance, CPA Verification, and Company Incorporation Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs, Department of Commercial Affairs, Taiwan Company Registration One-Stop Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining foreign investment approval, open a temporary capital account in the proposed company name and remit the subscribed capital from the foreign investor. Once funds are credited, instruct a Taiwan licensed certified public accountant to prepare a capital verification report. Submit the registration application to the MOEA Portal with the Articles of Incorporation, share subscription ledger, consents of directors and corporate secretary, registered office lease and landlord use consent, company seal card, and approved foreign investment letter. Pay the registration fee and stamp tax, and monitor the status until the Company Registration Certificate and unified business number (GUI number) are issued.
required_dossiers: Foreign investment approval letter
Temporary capital account deposit certificate
Capital verification report by Taiwan CPA
Articles of Incorporation signed by shareholders
Share subscription and payment ledger
Consent letters of directors, supervisor, and manager
Registered office lease and landlord consent
Company seal card and specimen
MOEA Company Registration Application Form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the MOEA issues a deficiency notice, correct and re-submit through the portal within 10 business days. If the company name is rejected, resubmit with an alternate approved name. If the capital verification report is rejected due to insufficient deposit, deposit the shortfall and obtain a supplemental CPA report. If the registration is revoked or refused, file an administrative appeal under the Administrative Litigation Act within 30 days, or restart the application with a fresh filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Profit-Seeking Enterprise Tax and Labor Insurance Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Taxation Bureau of the Ministry of Finance (regional jurisdiction) and Bureau of Labor Insurance / National Health Insurance Administration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Immediately after the company registration certificate is received, complete profit-seeking enterprise tax registration through the Ministry of Finance online platform within 15 days. Submit the company registration details, unified business number, registered office address, director identification, and business scope. The tax authority will issue a tax registration certificate and assign the enterprise to a business tax filing category. The company shall also register as an employer with the Bureau of Labor Insurance for labor insurance and with the NHI system for employees, and start monthly premium payment obligations. Because the company sells digital media and AI-asset services, a CPA should confirm the application of business tax and any cross-border tax exemptions.
required_dossiers: Company Registration Certificate and GUI number
Company Articles of Incorporation
Company seal and director identification
Tax Registration Application Form
Registered office lease contract
Articles and foreign investor approval letter
Labor Insurance and National Health Insurance registration forms
Statement of employees and payroll records
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the National Taxation Bureau issues a correction notice, supply missing documents within five business days. If the tax classification is disputed, apply for a binding advance ruling and request an extension. Late filing penalties may be waived if the company voluntarily corrects before audit. For labor insurance deficiencies, refile within 14 days and submit corrected payroll schedules; any unauthorized penalty may be administratively appealed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening, Municipal Commercial Filing, and Platform Onboarding
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Designated commercial bank, Taipei City Government Department of Economic Development or municipal commercial registry, and digital platform payment gateways (Stripe and PayPal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate operating bank account at the designated bank. Present original company registration certificate, tax registration, Articles of Incorporation, board resolution, directors' passports, and the board-authorized signature card. The bank will screen the investor under AML and perform beneficial ownership disclosure, and will typically request a recent utility bill or lease proving the physical office. Thereafter, file any municipal commercial registration required by the Taipei City Government if selling goods or services locally; for the online-only stock media and generative AI visual assets business, no physical operating license is required. Complete Stripe and PayPal merchant onboarding using the GUI number and corporate documents, and implement a data protection notice under the Personal Data Protection Act.
required_dossiers: Certified board resolution authorizing bank signatories
Company Registration Certificate and tax registration certificate
Articles of Incorporation and company seal
Director identification and proof of residential address
Registered office proof and landlord consent
Municipal commercial registration application (if required)
Stripe and PayPal merchant application forms and platform policy statements
Beneficial ownership declaration and AML source-of-funds documentation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank holds the account for compliance reasons, submit the requested beneficiary ownership evidence or source-of-wealth questionnaire. If the municipal commerce office demands a fire safety installation certificate before occupancy, obtain the building owner's fire inspection Form and record of installation. If the municipal registration is denied, appeal to the Municipal Administrative Appeals Committee within 14 days. For payment gateway rejections, appeal under the merchant contract by submitting a corporate due diligence package, or use an alternate licensed processor.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not Applicable - no industrial licensing board is required for a digital-only stock photography and generative visual asset marketplace.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no statutory operating license required under ISIC 7420 or NAICS 541922 for online commercial stock photo and AI visual asset services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Administration (EPA) of Taiwan - Not Applicable.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - no full EIA, environmental registration, or site pollution audit required because the business has no physical manufacturing, chemical processing, assembly, or warehousing operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not Applicable; the company does not generate industrial wastewater, VOC emissions, or hazardous waste. General office waste must be disposed through permissible municipal waste services under the Waste Disposal Act, and electronic equipment must be recycled under recycling labeling regulations if disposed.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not Applicable - no Civil Defense fire permit, structural load inspection, or Occupational Safety and Health plant clearance is required for the virtual/consulting service. If an administrative office is ever physically occupied, it must still comply with the Building Act and local fire safety installation regulations, including smoke alarms and emergency exits, and with the Occupational Safety and Health Act for general workplace safety before employees enter.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (中国人民银行, PBOC) acting as the central monetary authority, together with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (国家外汇管理局, SAFE) as the delegated foreign-exchange regulatory administrator. Commercial banks are designated as settlement banks executing FX controls under SAFE's centralized registration and monitoring systems.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The RMB is fully convertible for current account transactions, including cross-border service income from stock-photography licensing and AI visual-asset royalties, subject to documentary authenticity verification by the settling bank. The capital account remains managed and only partially convertible: FDI equity injections, capital account receipts, and offshore financing are admitted through SAFE registration and restricted-use rules. Profit remittance by the Taiwan-invested WFOE entails three mandatory conditions before the dividend can leave China: (i) completion of the PRC statutory annual audit by a domestic CPA; (ii) full settlement of PRC corporate income tax, including the 10% non-resident enterprise withholding tax on dividends to the Taiwan shareholder (no PRC-Taiwan double-tax treaty applies); and (iii) submission of the board dividend resolution, audited financial statements, tax filing and tax clearance evidence, and the cross-border service trade tax filing record (税务备案表) to the remitting bank. Once those documents are verified, dividend remittance is processed as a current account outflow without separate SAFE approval.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The mandatory foreign-currency surrender regime (强制结汇) was abolished in 2012. Under SAFE's Trade in Goods and Trade in Services monitoring frameworks, export proceeds must be repatriated into the WFOE's domestic foreign-exchange accounts; for goods exports the standard collection window is monitored at ninety (90) days from customs declaration for advance receipts and one hundred eighty (180) days for open-account proceeds, with extensions obtainable through the SAFE monitoring system where contractual payment terms exceed the deadline. For digital service exports such as stock-photo and AI visual-asset licensing, the repatriation obligation is verified through digital-delivery contracts, marketplace platform settlement statements, and tax filings. There is no statutory conversion ratio: once repatriated, the WFOE may freely retain the foreign currency or convert it into CNY at the onshore market rate, provided each settlement is traceable to an underlying commercial transaction and recorded under the applicable SAFE purpose code.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMIs (e.g., Airwallex, Currencycloud, Skye Pay) are rated Medium viability. They are legally usable as multi-currency collection accounts for overseas marketplace proceeds (e.g., Adobe Stock, Alamy, Stripe-settled offshore entities) provided the EMI does not carry out onshore payment business in China; all onshore collections from mainland customers must be settled through a PBOC-licensed payment institution or a domestic bank account. Stripe currently holds no onshore acquiring license in China, whereas PayPal operates through its licensed PRC subsidiary (PayPal/GoPay). Accordingly, the treasury structure should separate offshore PSP collection accounts from a domestic RMB settlement account, with repatriation by SWIFT MT103 into the WFOE's current-account FX settlement account under the export-proceeds rules.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under PBOC Customer Identification and Due Diligence rules, corporate account opening requires the legal representative or a duly authorized agent to undergo an in-person identity interview. Remote/video KYC is permitted only at the bank's discretion for low-risk profiles; for a Taiwan-invested WFOE the prevailing practice is a mandatory physical first interview of the legal representative and/or the ultimate beneficial owner. If the Taiwan-based legal representative cannot travel, the bank will require a Power of Attorney authenticated through the Cross-Strait SEF/ARATS notarization mechanism, the company seal registration certificate, a notarized shareholders' resolution, a certified copy of the business license, and identity documents of the authorized agent. The bank will additionally verify beneficial ownership through the national corporate information system and AML databases.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inability to substantiate the ultimate beneficial owner (UBO) of the Taiwan investment chain at or above the 25% threshold
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Corporate chain chart; certified incorporation documents and share registry of the Taiwan shareholder; SEF/ARATS-authenticated shareholder certificates; passport or Taiwan ID copies of the natural-person UBO; audited financial statements of the investor; signed declaration of source of funds and business purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Platform royalty flows through PayPal/Stripe mischaracterized as unlicensed payment institution activity
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed PSP merchant agreements naming the WFOE as principal; marketplace terms of service evidencing content-licensing royalties rather than money transmission; PayPal China payment business license and Stripe acquiring-partner licenses; treasury flow diagram demonstrating the PSP as settlement agent only; external AML/payments legal opinion.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume micro-royalty payouts to a global contributor base generating suspicious-transaction surveillance alerts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Standard contributor agreement and royalty schedule; batch payout reconciliation ledger; transaction monitoring programme description; contract with a licensed royalty payout processor; SAFE service-trade purpose codes mapped to each disbursement class; periodic AML reporting framework.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Opacity of ownership and licensing of AI-generated visual content within the stock-photo marketplace
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: IP assignment deeds from contributors and gen-AI model licensors; copyright registration certificates for flagship digital assets; published AI-content disclosure and takedown policy; customer-facing license terms proving the WFOE's commercial rights; evidence of compliance with applicable copyright and AI training-consent norms.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions or watchlist matches among global content buyers or contributors creating OFAC/EU/UN exposure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening logs produced by the compliance tool (OFAC/EU/UN/HK lists); geo-restriction evidence on the marketplace platform; customer and contributor due diligence forms; export-control classification memorandum (digital media, EAR99); restricted-party screening of the Taiwan parent and all PSP settlement channels.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Scope mismatch between the registered ISIC 7420 activity and revenue streams such as subscriptions, advertising, or AI training-data sales
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Revenue source breakdown mapped to ISIC 7420/NAICS 541922; supplemental business description filed with the corporate registry; service agreements and invoices for AI training-data licensing; tax and statistical returns; internal transfer-pricing documentation; representation letter confirming no unlicensed lending or investment business.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Routing sequence: (1) Execute the cash equity injection per the WFOE's amended articles of association; (2) complete FDI FX registration with SAFE via the chosen bank and obtain the Business Registration Certificate containing the FDI registration code; (3) open a dedicated Foreign-Exchange Capital Account (外汇资本金账户) at the bank; (4) the Taiwan shareholder remits via SWIFT MT103 with purpose code identifying equity investment and reference 'FDI registration No. [XXXX]'; the ordering customer must exactly match the registered shareholder and the beneficiary must exactly match the WFOE name; (5) upon receipt the bank verifies the registration and credits the capital account; (6) convert into RMB under the discretionary/voluntary settlement (意愿结汇) mechanism and park liquidity in the RMB funds settlement account, with each disbursement supported by invoice/contract evidence; (7) observe the negative-list usage restrictions, which prohibit deployment into securities, real estate beyond the licensed business scope, or entrusted loans; (8) for Taiwan-sourced capital, the outward remittance by the Taiwan shareholder must be pre-approved by the Taiwan Investment Commission (MOEAIC) where applicable, and cross-strait notarized ownership documents must be presented to the bank.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Royalty and licensing fees to global contributors are cleared by SWIFT MT103 customer credit transfers from the WFOE's current-account FX settlement account, using SAFE service-trade purpose codes under the intellectual-property-royalties category; each single payment above the regulatory threshold requires the cross-border service trade tax filing record (税务备案表) obtained online before the bank will release funds. For B2B licensing transactions involving physical media or structured enterprise orders, a Commercial Letter of Credit (SWIFT MT700/MT707) and documentary collection may be used, with the issuing bank reviewing the commercial invoice, digital delivery certificate and bill of lading or e-delivery receipt. For regular marketplace payouts, consolidated batch remittances through the corporate banking portal reduce cost and improve reconciliation. Where the WFOE maintains offshore PSP proceeds in Stripe or PayPal virtual accounts, the treasury policy requires periodic sweeping into the onshore current-account FX settlement account using MT103 with export-proceeds purpose codes and supporting platform settlement statements.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable CNY forward (远期结售汇) for hedging current-account receivables and payables, bookable only under the SAFE/PBOC real-demand principle with underlying trade documentation.
Onshore FX swap (外汇掉期) between CNY and USD/EUR/HKD for near-term liquidity conversion with an agreed reversal leg.
Vanilla foreign-exchange option (外汇期权) permitted for corporates with genuine current-account exposure, subject to bank product qualification and real-demand verification.
Cross-currency swap (货币互换) permissible in connection with cross-border financing or investment flows, provided the underlying capital-account transaction is SAFE-registered.

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are NOT bookable by the onshore WFOE without SAFE approval; a non-resident parent treasury centre may enter NDFs offshore, but hedge accounting cannot migrate onshore without transfer-pricing and regulatory review.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual regular shareholders meeting (股東常會) — presentation and approval of business report, financial statements, earnings appropriation, and board reports
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Shareholders at general meeting; minutes prepared, signed and distributed to every shareholder within 15 days under Company Act §170 and §183; copy retained in Corporate Minute Book
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before June 30 of each year for a December 31 fiscal year-end; MOEA may grant a 2-month extension upon application
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-compliance exposes directors to administrative fines; passed resolutions may be rescinded by court action under Company Act §189; continued default triggers MOEA enforcement and court-ordered dissolution

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statement filing with MOEA after shareholder approval (年度財務報表備查申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Economic Affairs (MOEA), Department of Commercial Affairs (經濟部商業司) — electronic company registration system
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days after approval at the annual shareholders meeting and in all events by June 30 of the following year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company Act §20(3) and §230: fine of NT$20,000–NT$1,000,000 on the responsible representative; MOEA may issue a compliance order and commence strike-off/dissolution proceedings upon continued default

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (營利事業所得稅結算申報) with unappropriated earnings schedule and prior-year loss offsets
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Finance, National Taxation Bureau (財政部國稅局) — local bureau with jurisdiction over the registered address
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 of the following calendar year; electronic filing is required for companies using licensed accountants or bookkeepers
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Income Tax Act §108: late-filing surcharge of 3% of unpaid tax (capped by total tax due); after a 30-day statutory notice a delinquency levy (怠報金) up to the unpaid tax amount applies; interest accrues on arrears under the Tax Collection Act

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial owner / UBO confirmation filing (公司法§22-1 董監事、經理人及大股東資訊申報)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: MOEA electronic company registration portal — competent authority for anti-money-laundering ownership transparency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 15 days of any change event and an annual confirmation update by June 30 of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Company Act §22-1: fine of NT$50,000–NT$5,000,000 against the company and responsible officer for each violation; repeated failures subject to continued administrative fines

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Compulsory CPA-audited financial statements with opinion letter (for entities above the §20 threshold)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Independent licensed CPA; signed audit opinion appended to the annual statement package submitted to MOEA and presented to shareholders
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Audit completed before the annual shareholders meeting; certified statements approved by June 30 and filed within the following 15 days
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: MOEA will reject the annual §20 filing lacking the CPA opinion; fine of NT$20,000–NT$1,000,000 on the responsible person; continuous default may lead to administrative deregistration

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Business tax (營業稅) quarterly returns reconciled annually with the corporate income tax return — applicable to stock photography licensing and digital AI content revenue
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Taxation Bureau via the electronic tax filing portal of the Ministry of Finance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Quarterly returns due by the 15th day of the month following each calendar quarter (January 15, April 15, July 15, October 15); annual income-tax reconciliation due by the following May 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Value-added and Non-value-added Business Tax Act §49: late filing fee of NT$1,200 (NT$3,000 for neglect); §51: penalty of one to ten times the underpaid tax where audit detects under-declaration

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent CPA audit under Company Act §20 and MOEA Order 87-207441: paid-in capital ≥ NT$30 million (approximately USD 990,000); annual revenue exceeding NT$100 million; or outstanding bank credit facilities exceeding NT$30 million. Below these thresholds the company may file unaudited statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Taiwan-IFRS (FSC-endorsed IFRS) applies to public companies; private limited companies use the Business Enterprises Accounting Standards (企業會計準則公報, BEAS — local GAAP) issued by the ARDF and recognized by the FSC, with voluntary adoption of full Taiwan-IFRS permitted

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under Company Act §22-1, the company must maintain a current register of every director, supervisor, manager, and any shareholder holding 10% or more of the issued shares; changes must be filed with the MOEA electronic registry within 15 days, and an annual confirmation must be completed by June 30 to satisfy anti-money-laundering transparency obligations before operational licenses and banking relationships can be renewed
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Shareholders register (股東名冊) maintained under Company Act §169 including shareholding percentages and transfer history
Register of directors and supervisors reflecting appointments, resignations, and 10%+ ultimate beneficial ownership
Corporate minute book containing shareholders' general meeting and board meeting resolutions
Company registration seal (印鑑) control record together with the original Certificate of Incorporation and MOEA registration certificates

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 300–1,200 per year (NT$10,000–35,000) covering a licensed corporate agent, registered address, mail forwarding, and registry liaison services
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,000–20,000 per year (NT$160,000–640,000) depending on transaction volume, cross-border licensing contracts, and the number of AI content revenue streams requiring BEAS or Taiwan-IFRS certification

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: No statutory tax holiday for commercial stock photography and generative visual assets. A qualifying innovative business may claim research and development expense credits and certain investment tax credits. Undistributed earnings are additionally subject to a 5% retained-earnings surtax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Taiwan Profit-Seeking Enterprise Income Tax Return (Form 15), filed electronically through the Ministry of Finance tax e-filing portal or the approved tax agency filing system.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return shall be filed within five months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year taxpayer the deadline is 31 May. Quarterly provisional income tax payments are due in September and December of the year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross revenue from stock photo licensing, AI image subscription fees, royalties and related service income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not applicable to a non-resident shareholder; the Taiwan WFOE will report all gross revenue.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of goods sold or service cost, including direct platform hosting and content acquisition costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be substantiated with invoices and contracts; non-resident vendors are not to file this form.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross profit or loss, being revenue less cost of goods sold.
Operating expenses: salaries, rent, marketing, software R&D and administrative overhead.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to non-resident service providers may trigger withholding tax documentation; the expense itself is reported here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Operating profit or loss after operating expenses.
Non-operating income and gains, including foreign exchange gains, interest and miscellaneous income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholding tax credits from non-resident source interest may be included here.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-operating expenses and losses, such as impairment charges and exchange losses.
Net income before tax before the loss carryforward.
Deduction of prior-year losses carried forward within the 10-year statutory window.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carryforward is limited to the Taiwan-resident WFOE itself.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after the loss carryforward.
Corporate income tax at the 20% statutory rate applied to taxable income.
Less: investment tax credits and other statutory credits (e.g., R&D credit).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Credits generally apply only to the Taiwan taxpayer.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net income tax payable before provisional payments.
Less: withholding tax credits and quarterly provisional payments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Withholding tax withheld by payers outside Taiwan may be credited only by the Taiwan-resident company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Balance of self-assessed tax due or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For non-resident shareholders, distributions are subject to separate withholding tax obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a surcharge of 3% of the unpaid tax for each full or partial two-month delay, capped at 10% of the tax. Late payment accrues collection interest at 1.5% per month. Under-declaration and falsification expose the company to a penalty of one to three times the underpaid tax under the Income Tax Act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 21% on dividends distributed by a Taiwan-resident profit-seeking enterprise to a non-resident enterprise shareholder.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No effective Taiwan-China comprehensive double taxation agreement is currently in force. The 2015 Cross-Strait Tax Agreement has been signed but is not implemented. Consequently, statutory 21% withholding applies to dividend distributions to a Mainland China parent. If a double taxation agreement with another jurisdiction applies, the non-resident shareholder must submit a Certificate of Tax Residence plus a withholding tax relief application to the Taiwan tax authority before distribution; the payer may apply the treaty rate only after administrative approval or after filing for a refund.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding tax on royalty income paid to non-residents is 20% and on interest income paid to non-residents is 15%. Under the unimplemented 2015 Cross-Strait Tax Agreement, prospective rates are 10% for royalties and 7% for interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Local File is mandatory when annual related-party transactions aggregate NT$50 million or more. Master File is required when the ultimate parent company's consolidated annual revenue exceeds NT$60 billion or when the Taiwan entity is designated as a significant contributor. Country-by-Country reporting applies to groups with consolidated revenue exceeding NT$60 billion.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Taiwan does not maintain a standalone Economic Substance Regulations code. However, under Taiwan's general anti-avoidance principle and the substance-over-rule doctrine, a Taiwan WFOE must demonstrate real business substance through local employees, active board management, local bank accounts and commercial contracts in Taiwan; a pure conduit arrangement is subject to income recharacterisation and penalty assessment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberately under-reporting Stripe, PayPal or stock photography licensing revenue; fabricating invoices; inflating royalty costs; or suppressing taxable receipts through the use of offshore payment accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority will reassess underpaid corporate income tax plus a penalty of one to three times the underpaid amount under Article 110 of the Income Tax Act. Interest runs monthly from the due date. The five-year audit window applies, and favorable tax credits are withdrawn.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly execute fraudulent returns face criminal liability under the Criminal Code (forgery and fraud), with imprisonment up to five years. The court may pierce the corporate veil, impose travel bans, order civil restitution from personal assets, and hold directors jointly and severally liable for the tax shortfall.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company or Artificial Conduit Arrangement
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a Taiwan entity with no employees, no local decision-making, no Taiwan bank account, and no commercial activity while channelling stock-photo royalties or IP income through tax-haven intermediaries solely to avoid tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Tax Administration Act and substance-over-form doctrine, the arrangement is disregarded; the Taiwan WFOE is reassessed on an arm's-length basis, denied deductions, charged 20% corporate income tax plus 5% retained earnings surtax, and fined for non-genuine registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where the legal entity is a mere facade, directors and ultimate beneficial owners may be held personally liable for unpaid taxes. Civil restitution, freezing orders, travel bans and, in egregious cases, imprisonment for criminal tax avoidance are available.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling photo licences to a related mainland China or Hong Kong distribution affiliate at below cost, or paying above-market service fees to a related trademark or technology holder to shift profit out of Taiwan.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The tax authority adjusts cross-border related-party income to an arm's length price under Article 43-1 of the Income Tax Act. The adjustment results in additional taxable income, additional 20% tax, late payment interest, and a penalty of one to three times the deficient tax for unreasonable transfer pricing.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign fraudulent or grossly negligent transfer pricing disclosures are exposed to personal liability in the event of corporate insolvency. Personal criminal liability attaches only where intentional concealment is proven; in that case imprisonment and travel bans may be ordered.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Accepting Stripe/PayPal revenue for stock-photo sales without implementing basic AML customer due diligence; repeatedly splitting transactions or converting receivables through crypto-asset brokers to avoid tax reporting.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violation of the Money Laundering Control Act results in corrective orders and an administrative fine of up to NT$5 million. If hidden income is later discovered, the tax evasion penalty of one to three times the tax is added.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML compliance officers may be personally fined up to NT$1 million. Money laundering involving criminal proceeds carries imprisonment of six months to five years, travel bans and confiscation of assets.
